The set S is an ellipsoid centered at the origin. Using the point-to-plane distance formula,

- d1 = |x - z|/sqrt(2)
- d2 = |x - 2y + z|/sqrt(6)
- d3 = |x + y + z|/sqrt(3)

so

(x - z)^2/2 + (x - 2y + z)^2/6 + (x + y + z)^2/3 = 36.

Expanding and simplifying gives

x^2 + 2y^2 + z^2 + xy + xz - yz = 18.

Thus the enclosed region is the solid ellipsoid

x^2 + 2y^2 + z^2 + xy + xz - yz <= 18.

Its volume is

V = 4\pi/3 \cdot \sqrt{\frac{18^3}{\det A}},

where A is the symmetric matrix

[[1, 1/2, 1/2],
 [1/2, 2, -1/2],
 [1/2, -1/2, 1]].

Here det(A) = 3, so

V = 4\pi/3 \cdot \sqrt{5832/3} = 4\pi/3 \cdot 18\sqrt{3} = 24\pi\sqrt{3}.

Therefore, the volume enclosed by S is 24\pi\sqrt{3}.

The set S is an ellipsoid. Using the distance-to-plane formula, the condition becomes
\[
\frac{(x-z)^2}{2}+\frac{(x-2y+z)^2}{6}+\frac{(x+y+z)^2}{3}=36.
\]
Expanding and simplifying gives
\[
2x^2+2y^2+2z^2-xy+2yz+2xz=36.
\]
Equivalently, in matrix form this is \(\mathbf{x}^T A\mathbf{x}=36\), where
\[
A=\begin{pmatrix}2&-\tfrac12&1\\-\tfrac12&2&1\\1&1&2\end{pmatrix}.
\]
The volume enclosed by the ellipsoid is
\[
V=\frac{4\pi}{3}\cdot \frac{36^{3/2}}{\sqrt{\det A}}.
\]
Since \(\det A=\frac{9}{2}\), we get
\[
V=\frac{4\pi}{3}\cdot \frac{216}{3/\sqrt2}=96\pi\sqrt2.
\]
So the enclosed volume is \(\boxed{96\pi\sqrt2}\).
